vetSays.line: "You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." Better close to the fire today.
A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +4 clean.

A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)

You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 60s telling Chantal about A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.

👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "I noticed that too. There's more — look closer next time."

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 40s, with a shaved head telling A man, maybe 20s about A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
📋 A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
🛡️ Gloria, George, Ha-rin, Ye-eun and Leo met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Gloria, George, Ha-rin, Ye-eun, Leo are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leo just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ George, Leo, Boris and Petra met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. George, Leo, Boris, Petra are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leo just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Leo met them at the door — 1 put down.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leo just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruth just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Leo, Ruth and Sigrun met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Ruth, Sigrun are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sanne just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
